translation: 嘿，你好！别见外，快进来吧！

raw_source: Bye for now! You take care, you hear!
translation: 先这样啦！你多保重，听见没！

raw_source: You're kinda early! Come back later and we can chat and drink, alright?
translation: 你来得有点早！晚点再来，咱们喝点东西聊聊天，好吗？

raw_source: Well! That last quake just wrecked my whole supply!
translation: 唉！上次地震把我的存货全毁了！

raw_source: I'll tell you what though, you seem like you're a good strong pupper.
translation: 不过说真的，你看着是只挺棒又壮实的狗狗。

raw_source: Another one of you cosmofellas came by muttering that they left
translation: 之前还来过一个跟你一样的太空伙计，嘴里嘀咕着说把

raw_source: their weapon just north of here!
translation: 武器落在这儿正北边了！

raw_source: "Bottom, middle, middle, top..." is what they kept saying, whatever that means!
translation: 那家伙一直念叨着"下、中、中、上……"，谁知道是什么意思！

raw_source: If nobody's claimed that ol' weapon yet, it's as good as yours, I say! Take it!
translation: 要是那把旧武器还没人认领，我说就归你了！拿去吧！

raw_source: Oh hi there! I haven't seen another agent in weeks!
translation: 哦，你好呀！我好几周没见别的特工了！

raw_source: I'll be right along, heheh! My leg kinda fell asleep...
translation: 我马上跟来，嘿嘿！腿好像有点睡麻了……

raw_source: Bye bye! I'll be waiting...
translation: 再见啦！我会等着的……

raw_source: Huh? Oh. It's just a dog.
translation: 嗯？哦。原来只是只狗。

raw_source: I guess you can't help me get out of here, huh girl?
translation: 你大概没法帮我出去吧，小姑娘？

raw_source: Oh, are you going to get help? Yay!
translation: 哦，你要去找人帮忙吗？太好啦！

raw_source: Oh... I guess you aren't going to let me out...?
translation: 哦……看来你不打算放我出去……？

raw_source: I've been cooped up in here forever and it's sooo boring!
translation: 我被关在这里好久了，真是无聊透了！

raw_source: Will you let me out, pleeease?
translation: 放我出去好不好，求——你啦？

raw_source: Wow! My heroine!
translation: 哇！我的女英雄！

raw_source: Thanks for double-checking, but I'll be fine!
translation: 谢谢你又来确认，不过我没事啦！

raw_source: Some big kobolds locked me up in here.
translation: 几个大块头狗头人把我关在这里了。

raw_source: And I thought they were my friends...
translation: 我还以为他们是我的朋友呢……

raw_source: I'll see you back at the hangar!
translation: 我们回机库再见！

raw_source: Ooohhh! You're a sight for sore eyes!
translation: 哦哦哦！见到你可真是太好了！

raw_source: I'm heading back to the hangar. Think I've had enough of this mission!
translation: 我回机库去了。这任务我算是受够了！

raw_source: C-c'mon, you've *got* to get me out of here! You don't know what it's like!
translation: 拜、拜托，你*一定*得把我救出去！你不知道这里有多难熬！

raw_source: I wanna run and jump, but I've been cooped up here for weeks...!
translation: 我想跑跑跳跳，可我已经被关在这里好几个星期了……！

raw_source: I... a dog?!
translation: 我……一只狗？！

raw_source: Please help me, good girl! You just gotta find someone...
translation: 帮帮我，乖姑娘！你只要去找个人来……

raw_source: Come back soon! I can't take much more of this boring room!
translation: 快点回来！这无聊的房间我真的快待不下去了！

raw_source: Don't tease me... please... just lemme out now!
translation: 别逗我了……求你……现在就放我出去吧！

raw_source: You'll need a key! I've tried... everything...
translation: 你得有钥匙！我已经……什么办法都试过了……

raw_source: Please unlock my cell! Let me go free!
translation: 求你打开牢门！放我自由吧！

raw_source: Thank you Yiffany! Thank you!
translation: 谢谢你，伊法妮！谢谢你！

raw_source: You'll need a key! I've tried... everything...
translation: 你得有钥匙！我已经……什么办法都试过了……

raw_source: I'm fine now. Just need a minute to stretch my legs.
translation: 我现在没事了。只需要点时间活动活动腿脚。

raw_source: They locked me up in this cell as soon as we landed!
translation: 我们刚降落，他们就把我关进了这间牢房！

raw_source: I'm going stir crazy in here! I just wanna ruuun!
translation: 我被关得都快疯了！我只想出去跑——啊！

raw_source: Actually I feel like my legs are kinda cramped now...
translation: 其实现在感觉腿好像有点抽筋了……

raw_source: So I'll probably just make my way back to the hangar and relax.
translation: 所以我大概会先慢慢回机库，休息一下。

raw_source: Well hey there, little lady. I gots some real pree-mo dining here.
translation: 哟，小妞。我这儿可有顶级好菜。

raw_source: Well look what we have here! Come in, come in! Welcome to my junk shop!
translation: 哟，瞧瞧谁来了！进来进来！欢迎光临我的杂货铺！

raw_source: Be seeing you. Heh-heh...
translation: 回头见。嘿嘿……

raw_source: Take care out there. Ole Tutone's a rough place these days.
translation: 出门小心点。如今这老图托恩可不太平。

raw_source: Remember, no refunds! What else you need? He! He! He!
translation: 记住，概不退款！还要什么？嘿！嘿！嘿！

raw_source: Thanks for taking that off my hands.
translation: 多谢你帮我把这东西脱手。

raw_source: They get a bit uppity at 3P stations when you gots stolen equipment...
translation: 带着偷来的装备去3P站点，那帮人可就要摆脸色了……

raw_source: Well are you buying or not? Don't waste my time...
translation: 到底买不买？别浪费我时间……

raw_source: You stupid or something?! That was my last one!
translation: 你傻了还是咋的？！那是最后一个！

raw_source: This ain't a peepshow, punk! Show me the lect or get out!
translation: 这儿不是给你白看的，混蛋！掏LECT，不然滚！

raw_source: Hey, you don't even have room for that!
translation: 喂，你都没地方装这个了！

raw_source: The slaves always gimme lip about the flies. Extra protein, I say!
translation: 奴隶老跟我抱怨苍蝇。我说这叫加餐补蛋白！

raw_source: I gotta be honest with you, I don't know what animal this is from.
translation: 说实话，我也不知道这是从哪种动物身上弄来的。

raw_source: Makes for good drinkin' if you're *real* thirsty though.
translation: 不过你要是*真*渴得不行，喝着倒还不错。

raw_source: Business been pretty good lately, what with all you spacebrats wandering around.
translation: 最近生意可不错，全靠你们这帮太空崽子到处乱跑。

raw_source: This here? One of them tazers those cute lil spacebrats carry around.
translation: 这个？就是那帮可爱太空崽子随身带的电击枪。

raw_source: A real primo, high end model too... except it's broken.
translation: 还是顶级的高端型号呢……只可惜坏了。

raw_source: But the scrap alone will go for a thousand lect, off world. How about it?
translation: 不过光是这些废料，拿到外星都能卖一千LECT。怎么样？

raw_source: All the cosmo-junk I sell has a story behind it.
translation: 我卖的每件宇宙破烂背后都有故事。

raw_source: Reeeall good stories, heh-heh...
translation: 那可都是绝——妙的故事，嘿嘿……

raw_source: You smell pretty cute for a kobold, heh-heh. What crew you fly in with?
translation: 你身上这味道对科博德来说真够可爱的，嘿嘿。你跟哪一伙船员一起飞？

raw_source: What the-? A dog?!
translation: 什么鬼——？一条狗？！

raw_source: Scram, mutt! Get back in the cage!
translation: 滚开，杂种狗！回笼子里去！

raw_source: Rawr! Come right on in, but only if you have plenty of Lect on you! Rawr!
translation: 嗷！尽管进来，不过身上得带够Lect才行！嗷！

raw_source: Grrr, bring more Lect with you next time, ya scoundrel!
translation: 咕呜，下次多带点 Lect 来，你这混蛋！

raw_source: Look I know it's hard to believe, but I'm not actually a Kobold pirate!
translation: 听着，我知道这很难相信，但我其实不是科博德海盗！

raw_source: It's true! But if you want a disguise as good as mine, you can buy this.
translation: 真的！不过你要是想弄一身跟我一样好的伪装，可以买这个。

raw_source: You'll need the full set in order to fool folks, but trust me...
translation: 想骗过别人，你得凑齐一整套，不过相信我……

raw_source: ...it's the only way to get the GOOD goods from the slavers, hehe!
translation: ……这是从奴隶贩子那儿弄到「好货」的唯一办法，嘿嘿！

raw_source: Plus, I'll throw in a map to the other disguise parts too!
translation: 另外，我还会顺带送你一张标注其他伪装部件的地图！

raw_source: A real live psy crystal, just like those espers use!
translation: 货真价实的精神力水晶，跟那些超能力者用的一样！

raw_source: Just look at this thick and meaty shank! Juicy and VIT-filling!
translation: 瞧瞧这粗壮又多肉的腿肉！鲜嫩多汁，还能补充活力！

raw_source: I know I look like a Space Pirate, but I'm really just a dog like you!
translation: 我知道自己像太空海盗，但我跟你一样只是条狗！

raw_source: If you get a full set of Kobo gear, you could fool people too.
translation: 要是弄到一整套科博装备，你也能骗过别人。

raw_source: The scariest part about this outfit...
translation: 这身行头最吓人的地方……

raw_source: ...is that sometimes the zipper gets stuck!
translation: ……就是拉链有时候会卡住！

raw_source: Don't forget to take some food for your pets!
translation: 别忘了给你的宠物带点吃的！

raw_source: Oh hey! Sorry, I didn't see you come in there.
translation: 哦嘿！抱歉，我没看见你走进来。

raw_source: ...in fact, I can't see anything! It's too dark!
translation: ……其实我什么都看不见！这里太黑了！

raw_source: And here you are, to brighten up my day!
translation: 你一来，我这一天都亮堂了！

raw_source: You and that torch are lifesavers.
translation: 你和那支手电筒真是救星。

raw_source: If you come across a lantern or something, come share some light with me, eh?
translation: 要是找到灯笼什么的，就来给我也照个亮，好吗？

raw_source: Look buddy, if I could see where anything is I'd gladly sell that to you
translation: 听着，老兄，要是我能看清东西在哪儿，我很乐意卖给你

raw_source: But every time I move I seem to step on somethi-YEOWCH!
translation: 但我每次一动，好像都会踩到什——嗷呜！

raw_source: Nope, no sales until the lights are back on. Sorry!
translation: 不行，灯亮之前不卖东西。抱歉！

raw_source: This is a pretty little elven letter opener, if I do say so myself!
translation: 要我自己说，这可是一把精巧的精灵拆信刀！

raw_source: Feather light, just like how those dresses the elves craft will make you feel.
translation: 轻得像羽毛，就像精灵们缝的那些裙子会让你感觉的那样。

raw_source: ...not that I would know anything about those!
translation: ……那些裙子我一点都不了解！

raw_source: This here little pill will perk you up, thicken your hair, straighten yer back...
translation: 这颗小药丸能让你精神抖擞、毛发浓密、腰板挺直……

raw_source: ...and even increase your vitality!
translation: ……甚至还能提升你的活力！

raw_source: Now how about that?
translation: 怎么样，厉害吧？

raw_source: This is just my luck, isn't it?
translation: 我的运气还真是好啊，是吧？

raw_source: First somewan stole my hookshot so I have to walk around on these tiny legs...
translation: 先是有人偷了我的钩索，害我只能靠这两条小短腿走路……

raw_source: ...and now the power is out and my flashlight is missing! Bah!
translation: ……而现在又停电了，手电筒也不见了！哼！

raw_source: It's been getting ruffer and ruffer to do business around these parts, let me tell ya.
translation: 跟你说吧，在这一带做生意是越来越难了。

raw_source: Earthquakes happen every other hour and the monsters are rowdier than ever...
translation: 隔一个小时就地震一次，魔物也比以前更闹腾了……

raw_source: ...it almost feels like things are building up to something!
translation: ……总觉得好像有什么大事要发生了！

raw_source: So anyways, you ever wear an Elven dress before? You look like the sort!
translation: 话说回来，你以前穿过精灵连衣裙吗？你看着就像会穿的！

raw_source: Rumors say they prevent blocks from crumbling beneath your feet
translation: 听说它们能防止脚下的方块崩塌，

raw_source: thanks to some sort of nano machines...
translation: 靠的是什么纳米机器……

raw_source: ...but I think it's actually just magic!
translation: ……不过我觉得其实就是魔法！

raw_source: Well, about time. I've been waiting for backup!
translation: 总算来了。我等增援都等好久了！

raw_source: Those space pirates are gonna regret crossing me...
translation: 那些太空海盗一定会后悔招惹我……

raw_source: Really? Trust me girl, you *don't* want to get on my bad side.
translation: 真要这样？相信我，姑娘，你*绝对不会*想惹恼我的。

raw_source: Dang, just a dog.
translation: 啧，只是只狗。

raw_source: Are you gonna make yourself useful and go get help, or just stand there?
translation: 你是打算帮点忙去找人来，还是就这么站着？

raw_source: Hmf, just my luck...
translation: 哼，我这是什么运气……

raw_source: Quit fooling around and bust me out of here. Don't make me say it twice.
translation: 别磨蹭了，把我从这里弄出去。别让我说第二遍。

raw_source: It's a basic forcefield, girl. Your tazer will make short work of it.
translation: 这就是个基本款力场，姑娘。你的电击枪一下就能搞定它。

raw_source: Finally! I've been cooped up in here forever!
translation: 终于！我被关在这鬼地方都这么久了！

raw_source: No need. I'll take it from here.
translation: 不用了。接下来交给我吧。

raw_source: Look, as nice as it is to chit-chat...
translation: 听着，闲聊虽然不错……

raw_source: ...we've both got better things to be doing, right?
translation: ……可我们都有更要紧的事要做，对吧？

raw_source: Time for some payback! I'll be queen of the space pirates yet!
translation: 是时候报仇了！我终会成为太空海盗女王！

raw_source: ...metaphorically. I'm not hanging up my cosmosuit or anything.
translation: ……只是个比喻。我还没打算把宇宙服挂起来退役呢。

raw_source: Oh hey, what brings you here?
translation: 哦，嗨，你怎么来了？

raw_source: I guess I'll get back to the hangar and start filing my reports...
translation: 看来我得回机库，开始整理报告了……

raw_source: Don't worry about me, ehehe...
translation: 不用担心我，诶嘿嘿……

raw_source: Heey there doggy.
translation: 嗨——小狗狗。

raw_source: Do you wanna hang out and enjoy the forest with me?
translation: 想留下来，和我一起享受森林吗？

raw_source: I guess not, huh?
translation: 看来是不想，是吧？

raw_source: Really, no need to bust things up on my account. I'm doing great, eh-heh.
translation: 真的，没必要为了我砸坏东西。我过得挺好的，诶嘿。

raw_source: Really? Do you *have* to bust me out of here?
translation: 真的？你*非得*把我弄出去吗？

raw_source: Meep... guess you're telling me to get back to work...
translation: 呜……看来你是叫我回去工作啊……

raw_source: Yeah yeah, I'll start working on my paperwork...
translation: 好啦好啦，我会开始处理文书的……

raw_source: Honestly, all the running around and training fauna was soo tiring.
translation: 说实话，到处跑来跑去、训练动物，真的好累。

raw_source: I don't mind a little vacation, eheheh...
translation: 放个小假我也不介意，诶嘿嘿……

raw_source: Did I really look like I was in trouble or something?
translation: 我看起来真的像遇上麻烦了吗？

raw_source: Sceafya is really lovely...
translation: 斯凯菲亚真的很美……

raw_source: Ohmygawd, it's like, another cosmo-girl! Heeey!
translation: 天哪，居然又来了个太空女孩！嗨——！

raw_source: You're like, totally awesome, you know?
translation: 你简直就是超厉害的，你知道吗？

raw_source: I'm not in like, a hurry, you know? You could totally come back whenever!
translation: 我又不着急，你知道吗？你随时都可以再回来的！

raw_source: Oh, it's like, a dog...
translation: 哦，原来是条狗啊……

raw_source: Are you gonna be a buddy and go get someone with a key?
translation: 你要不要当个好伙伴，去叫个有钥匙的人来？

raw_source: Yeah, you're totally a good girl.
translation: 嗯，你真是个乖姑娘。

raw_source: Ohmygod stop being so harsh!
translation: 我的天，别这么凶嘛！

raw_source: You're gonna need like, a key, you know...?
translation: 你需要那种，钥匙，你懂吧……？

raw_source: So you got like, one of those keys...?
translation: 所以你是拿到那种钥匙了……？

raw_source: Ohmygosh thank you!
translation: 天哪，谢谢你！

raw_source: You're gonna need like, a key, you know...?
translation: 你需要那种，钥匙，你懂吧……？

raw_source: Girl, the door's like, already unlocked?
translation: 妹子，这门不是早就开着的吗？

raw_source: Don't worry about me, I'll be along later.
translation: 别担心我，我待会儿就跟上。

raw_source: I was just thinking, like, it'd be amaaazing if someone showed up to rescue me.
translation: 我刚刚还在想，要是有人来救我，那岂不是太——棒了。

raw_source: And like, here you are, you know?
translation: 然后呢，你就出现了，你懂吧？

raw_source: You know, I'm gonna miss chilling out here in the forest.
translation: 说真的，我会想念在森林里悠闲度日的时光。

raw_source: It's got some totally rad vibes!
translation: 这里的氛围简直棒极了！

raw_source: Nice night in the forest huh?
translation: 森林里今晚夜色不错，是吧？

raw_source: A fine night to enjoy some fine dining, wouldn't you say?
translation: 这样的夜晚正适合享用一顿美餐，你说是不是？

raw_source: Well lookee here, a friendly face. Welcome to the black market!
translation: 哟，瞧瞧这儿，一张友善的面孔。欢迎来到黑市！

raw_source: Be seeing you. Heh-heh...
translation: 回头见。嘿嘿……

raw_source: Take care out there. Ole Tutone's a rough place these days.
translation: 出门小心点。如今这老图托恩可不太平。

raw_source: Remember, no refunds! What else you need? He! He! He!
translation: 记住，概不退款！还要什么？嘿！嘿！嘿！

raw_source: Wow, thanks! I didn't think I'd ever find a kobold to buy these!
translation: 哇，多谢！我还以为找不到肯买这些的科博德呢！

raw_source: Well are you buying or not? Don't waste my time...
translation: 到底买不买？别浪费我时间……

raw_source: Just have fun with your trash and leave me be, okay?!
translation: 你就拿着你的破烂玩去吧，别来烦我，行吗？！

raw_source: Nope, no take-backs! I don't care how much those cards tingle in your pocket.
translation: 不行，没有反悔这回事！我才不管那些卡在你兜里有多让人发麻。

raw_source: This ain't a peepshow, punk! Show me the lect or get out!
translation: 这儿不是给你白看的，混蛋！掏LECT，不然滚！

raw_source: Hey, you don't even have room for that!
translation: 喂，你都没地方装这个了！

raw_source: What? You're interested in THAT?
translation: 什么？你对那玩意儿感兴趣？

raw_source: I have the finest food this side of the seven swamps, and you want THAT garbage?
translation: 我这儿的吃食是七片沼泽这一带最好的，你却想要那种垃圾？

raw_source: Fine, but it'll cost ya...
translation: 行吧，不过这可要花你钱的……

raw_source: Oh? You want to try my special meat?
translation: 哦？你想试试我的特别的肉？

raw_source: Can't say you don't have guts, heh-heh...
translation: 不能说你没胆子，嘿嘿……

raw_source: We boiled it for so long we forgot what it was.
translation: 我们煮了太久，都忘了它是什么。

raw_source: But a little sip never hurt anyone, right?
translation: 不过喝一小口从来不会伤到谁，对吧？

raw_source: You ever think about becoming a space pirate?
translation: 你有没有想过成为太空海盗？

raw_source: Lot more loot in it than being a cosmo agent, heh-heh...
translation: 比当宇宙特工能捞到的好处多多了，嘿嘿……

raw_source: Just looks like a deck of weird little cards... right? Think again!
translation: 看起来不过是一叠古怪的小卡片……对吧？那你可想错了！

raw_source: One touch, and you can feel the PSY power leaching off of them.
translation: 只要碰一下，你就能感觉到精神力正从上面渗出来。

raw_source: It's said that a skilled ESPer could *use* this power.
translation: 据说熟练的超能力者能够*使用*这种力量。

raw_source: I'll be honest: all this PSY stuff gives me the creeps.
translation: 老实说：这些精神力的东西让我发毛。

raw_source: Jus' don't blow me up and we'll be golden, okay?
translation: 就别把我炸了，咱们就妥了，好吗？

raw_source: Most kobolds don't really do all these mind games. I get it if y'ain't interested.
translation: 大多数科博德并不真搞这些心理把戏。你要是没兴趣，我理解。

raw_source: Any ole club and a length of rope'll do me just fine... All direct-like, ya-know?
translation: 随便一根旧棍子加一段绳子就够我用了……全都直接来的，懂吧？

raw_source: What the-? A dog?!
translation: 什么鬼——？一条狗？！

raw_source: Scram, mutt! You're not getting any food from me!
translation: 滚开，杂种狗！我这儿一点吃的都不会给你！

raw_source: Whew! What a climb up here huh? Really takes the wind out of ya!
translation: 呼！爬上来这一趟够呛吧？真是累得人喘不上气！

raw_source: You're real daring, going out without a spacesuit on!
translation: 不穿宇航服就往外跑，你胆子可真大！

raw_source: You get 'em, tiger!
translation: 加油，猛将，去收拾他们吧！

raw_source: Bye! I'd toast to your health, but I know you can't drink with that helm on!
translation: 再见！本想举杯祝你健康，可我知道你戴着那头盔没法喝！

raw_source: Fancy yourself an explorer?
translation: 觉得自己是个探险家？

raw_source: Then you probably aren't interested in this...
translation: 那你大概对这东西没兴趣……

raw_source: This little doohicky will detect anomalies
translation: 这小玩意儿能探测异常，

raw_source: and it'll even mark important things on your Navmap!
translation: 还能在你的导航地图上标出重要的东西！

raw_source: Great for cleaning up all the areas you've been to.
translation: 用来查漏补缺、扫遍去过的区域再合适不过了。

raw_source: Isn't technology great? This new G+RADIO is a radio and anomaly detector...
translation: 科技真棒，不是吗？这款新G+RADIO既是收音机，也是异常探测器……

raw_source: ...and it even has a calculator built in!
translation: ……甚至还内置了计算器！

raw_source: The worst part about all this space walking is having to wear a space suit.
translation: 太空行走最糟的，就是得穿宇航服。

raw_source: It gets my fur all mussed up!
translation: 弄得我的毛全乱了！

raw_source: Oh hi! Haven't seen one of you cosmo fellas in a while!
translation: 哦，你好！好久没见到你们这种宇宙来的家伙了！

raw_source: Welcome welcome! Bring your appetite! And your Lect!
translation: 欢迎欢迎！带上你的胃口！还有你的 Lect！

raw_source: Buh bye! I know we'll meat again!
translation: 拜拜啦！我知道我们还会再见的！

raw_source: Fried to perfection, this little snack will fill you with vigor!
translation: 这份小吃炸得恰到好处，吃了让你活力满满！

raw_source: Ahh, in need of something a bit more substantial, are ya? Good choice!
translation: 啊，想来点更顶饱的，是吧？好眼光！

raw_source: This premium slab of meat will get you back on your feet in no time!
translation: 这块上等好肉能让你立马恢复精神！

raw_source: Just look at this thick and meaty shank! Juicy and VIT-filling!
translation: 瞧瞧这粗壮又多肉的腿肉！鲜嫩多汁，还能补充活力！

raw_source: Heyhey, if it isn't the great hero of Tutone!
translation: 嘿嘿，这不是图托恩的大英雄嘛！

raw_source: With all these folks recovering here, business has been booming!
translation: 有这么多人在这一带养伤，生意可真是红火！

raw_source: Feel free to buy as much meat as you need, stocks won't run out.
translation: 想买多少肉尽管买，存货管够。

raw_source: Starting to get lively in here, isn't it?
translation: 这儿开始热闹起来了，是吧？

raw_source: I keep bringing in food, and you fellas keep on eating it up!
translation: 我一批批把吃的运进来，你们这帮家伙就一个劲地吃光！

raw_source: Almost makes me think that I should bring in some of the GOOD stuff...
translation: 都快让我觉得该进点“好东西”了……

raw_source: There's not much reason to stock a lot of food right now
translation: 眼下没什么理由囤太多吃的

raw_source: But you know, if there were more folks resting up in this hangar
translation: 不过你知道，要是这机库里歇着的人再多些

raw_source: I could probably stand to bring in more provisions...
translation: 我倒也许该多运些补给进来……

raw_source: It's been so long since I saw another one of you agent sorts here
translation: 我有多久没在这儿见到你们这种特工了

raw_source: that I haven't even kept the stocks up!
translation: 连存货都没顾上补！

raw_source: Maybe if there were folks to eat the food, I could bring some in...
translation: 要是有谁来吃这些东西，也许我就能进些货……

raw_source: Not hungry after all, huh?
translation: 到头来还是不饿，是吧？

raw_source: There you go! Eat up!
translation: 给你！尽情吃吧！

raw_source: Doesn't your boss pay ya? Come back with some more Lect!
translation: 你老板不给你发钱吗？多带点Lect再来！

raw_source: Hey there! Don't be a stranger, come on in!
translation: 嘿，你好！别见外，快进来吧！

raw_source: Bye for now! You take care, you hear!
translation: 先这样啦！你多保重，听见没！

raw_source: You come across any of these crazy crystals out there in the world?
translation: 你在外头见过这种神奇的水晶吗？

raw_source: They say that if an Esper gets one of these, it'd boost their psychic capacity
translation: 听说超能力者得到一颗，就能提升灵能容量，

raw_source: but I'm just a simple dog, so it does nothing for me. You can have it!
translation: 可我只是条普通的狗，这东西对我没用。送你吧！

raw_source: You been working real hard to rescue everyone, haven't you?
translation: 为了救大家，你一直很拼命吧？

raw_source: I've been busy running around from shop to shop making sure the lect flows
translation: 我忙着跑遍各家店，确保 lect 流转

raw_source: but every once in a while I need one of THESE as a lil pick-me-up!
translation: 不过偶尔我也得靠这个提提神！

raw_source: I reckon you could use one yourself about now, huh?
translation: 我寻思你这会儿也该来一份，嗯？

raw_source: I'm all out of fancy stones and meds now...
translation: 我现在已经没有那些稀奇的石头和药品了……

raw_source: ...but you know, you Cosmobreeders have been good to me
translation: ……不过，你们这些宇宙育种者一直待我不错，

raw_source: so why not take a little cut of what I've earned, huh? You deserve it!
translation: 所以从我赚的钱里拿一小份吧，怎么样？这是你应得的！

raw_source: You ever hear about these ol' PSY powers that some folks be gettin' these days?
translation: 你听说过近来有些人搞到的那些念力吗？

raw_source: The say Triangle powers will boost your defense while lowering your attack a bit
translation: 听说三角能力能增强防御，不过攻击会稍微降低

raw_source: while a Cross power will do the opposite! Take AND deal more damage!
translation: 而十字之力刚好相反！挨伤更多、伤人更多！

raw_source: Not only that, but they say... they say...
translation: 不止如此，他们说……他们说……

raw_source: ...nevermind, I forgot what they say about the other powers...
translation: ……算了，其他能力的传闻我给忘了……

raw_source: Sure are a lot of agents to rescue out there, huh?
translation: 外面要救的特工可真不少，是吧？

raw_source: Come back here after you've saved a bunch of 'em
translation: 等你救了一大批他们之后再回到这儿

raw_source: and I'll give you a little somethin somethin... He!He!He!
translation: 我就给你一点那个那个……嘿！嘿！嘿！

raw_source: ...sorry about the creepy laugh. Force of habit.
translation: ……抱歉，刚才笑得有点吓人。习惯了。

raw_source: There you go pal. You deserve it!
translation: 拿好了，伙计。这是你应得的！

raw_source: I'm out now, sorry! If I had more I'd gladly give 'em to ya!
translation: 抱歉，现在没货了！要是还有，我很乐意给你！

raw_source: COME ON IN, FELLOW BREEDER!
translation: 进来吧，同行育种者！

raw_source: BYE-OH! DON'T FORGET TO COME OFTEN!
translation: 拜拜！别忘了常来啊！

raw_source: THIS RIGHT HERE IS A TRAINER TAZER! MUCH DIFFERENT THAN THE TRAINEE TAZER!
translation: 这就是驯兽电击枪！跟学员电击枪可大不一样！

raw_source: IF YOU DEFEAT AN ENEMY WHILE WIELDING THIS, IT'LL SEND THE CREATURE HERE!
translation: 拿着它击败敌人，就会把那个生物传送到这里！

raw_source: AND WHILE THEY'RE HERE YOU CAN OBSERVE AND GROW YOUR RAPPORT WITH THEM
translation: 它们待在这里时，你可以观察它们，跟它们增进关系，

raw_source: TO UNDERSTAND MORE ABOUT THE SPECIES!
translation: 从而更深入地了解这个物种！

raw_source: NOT INTERESTED IN CAPTURING CREATURES? SURE, WE CAN TRADE BACK.
translation: 对捕捉生物没兴趣？没问题，我们可以换回来。

raw_source: YOU'RE WELCOME TO GET THE TRAINER TAZER AGAIN LATER, OF COURSE!
translation: 当然，以后想再拿驯兽电击枪，随时欢迎！

raw_source: SINCE YOU'VE GOTTEN REAL CLOSE WITH ONE OF THOSE CREATURES, TAKE THIS!
translation: 既然你已经和那些生物中的一个变得非常亲近了，把这个拿去！

raw_source: GIVE THEM SOME ATTENTION AND PETS ONE MORE TIME WHILE HOLDING THIS CRYSTAL
translation: 拿着这块水晶，再关心它们一次、摸摸它们。

raw_source: AND YOU MIGHT FEEL A CERTAIN POWER COURSE THROUGH YOU...
translation: 并且你也许会感到某种力量流经你……

raw_source: MAKE SURE TO SHOW YOUR PETS SOME AFFECTION, AND FEED THEM WELL!
translation: 一定要给宠物一点关爱，并且好好喂它们！

raw_source: AFTER YOU'VE MAXED A PET'S CONFIDENCE, RETURN HERE FOR A SPECIAL REWARD.
translation: 把宠物的自信提升到最高后，回来领取特别奖励。

raw_source: WITH THE CRYSTAL, THE CREATURES THAT LOVE YOU CAN GIVE YOU A SPECIAL BOOST!
translation: 有了这水晶，爱你的生物就能给你一份特殊加成！

raw_source: JUST PET THEM WHILE THEY'RE AT FULL CONFIDENCE TO CHARGE THE CRYSTAL.
translation: 在它们自信满满时抚摸它们，就能给水晶充能。

raw_source: EACH CREATURE GIVES A DIFFERENT POWER! TRY THEM ALL!
translation: 每种生物给的力量都不同！都试试！

raw_source: Welcome to my little shop!
translation: 欢迎光临我的小店！

raw_source: ...no, not that kind of shop! This is an auto shop!
translation: ……不，不是那种店！这是汽车修理店！

raw_source: Bye for now! You take care, you hear!
translation: 先这样啦！你多保重，听见没！

raw_source: I've asked around, and my sources say...
translation: 我打听了一圈，我的消息来源说……

raw_source: The southern part of Depot B holds a nice Ship Gun!
translation: B号仓库的南部有一门不错的飞船炮！

raw_source: It's right underneath the area where the lights go out
translation: 它就在那片灯光熄灭区域的正下方

raw_source: but you'll need a high level keycard to access it!
translation: 但你得有高级门卡才能进去！

raw_source: I've asked around, and my sources say...
translation: 我打听了一圈，我的消息来源说……

raw_source: Way down at the bottom of Ayskammr lies a nice Ship Shield!
translation: 在艾斯卡姆尔的最深处，躺着一面不错的飞船护盾！

raw_source: It's in a spooky dark cave, so try to take a light with ya!
translation: 它在一个阴森黑暗的洞穴里，所以记得带上照明！

raw_source: I've asked around, and my sources say...
translation: 我打听了一圈，我的消息来源说……

raw_source: The Elves of Sceafya have stowed away a Ship Radar!
translation: 斯凯菲亚的精灵们藏起了一台飞船雷达！

raw_source: Apparently it's in a tricky position...
translation: 据说它在一个很刁钻的位置……

raw_source: You're gonna have to be a magician or psychic to reach it!
translation: 你得是魔术师或者通灵者才够得着它！

raw_source: I've asked around, and my sources say...
translation: 我打听了一圈，我的消息来源说……

raw_source: Zeronia's really taken a beating since you got here!
translation: 自从你来了之后，泽罗尼亚可真是饱受摧残！

raw_source: Supposedly an old cache that held a Ship Turbo got revealed
translation: 据说一个装有飞船涡轮的旧藏匿点露了出来

raw_source: during the last batch of earthquakes! Go get it!
translation: 就在最近那几场地震期间！快去拿吧！

raw_source: Wow! You got a whole set of parts for this ol' ship of yours!
translation: 哇！你这艘老船的整套零件都齐了！

raw_source: I'll need time to install them, but it'll all work out now!
translation: 我需要时间把它们装上，不过现在一切都能搞定了！

raw_source: If you come across any nice upgrades for your ship out there
translation: 如果你在外面碰上什么不错的飞船升级件

raw_source: I'll install them for you, free of charge!
translation: 我就免费替你装上！

raw_source: ...well, not really free. Your boss paid me already!
translation: ……嗯，也不算真免费。你的老板已经付过我钱了！

raw_source: Don't worry about memorizing what I just told ya...
translation: 别费劲记我刚才说的那些……

raw_source: ...I marked it on your Navmap already! Go check it out!
translation: ……我已经在你的导航地图上标好了！去看看吧！

raw_source: Heyo sis! Welcome aboard!
translation: 嘿，姐！欢迎登船！

raw_source: Bye! If you wanna help me get this ship fixed up
translation: 再见！如果你想帮我把这艘船修好

raw_source: try asking the mechanic where you can get some parts!
translation: 就去问问机修工哪儿能弄到零件！

raw_source: I can't believe that I did that evil Queen's bidding...
translation: 真不敢相信，我竟然替那个邪恶女王卖命……

raw_source: She almost has enough power to take over a new body
translation: 她几乎已经有足够的力量占据一具新的身体了

raw_source: so we gotta hurry and strike before it's too late!
translation: 所以咱们得赶快出击，趁还来得及！

raw_source: Man, this ship got beat up pretty good, didn't it?
translation: 哇，这艘船伤得可真惨，是吧？

raw_source: I'd fly you straight to where that evil Queen is hiding
translation: 我会直接把你送到那个邪恶女王藏身的地方

raw_source: but this bird can't fly that high until it's fixed up!
translation: 但这艘船没修好之前可飞不了那么高！

raw_source: You always were the winner when we roughhoused...
translation: 以前咱们打打闹闹的时候，你总是赢的那个……

raw_source: ...but hey! I put up a good effort this time, right?
translation: ……不过嘿！这次我可是很拼的，对吧？

raw_source: Heya Yiffany! Nice to see you up here in my brand new spacelab!
translation: 嘿，伊法妮！很高兴在我全新的太空实验室里见到你！

raw_source: Heheh... I guess this used to be your brother's ship though, huh?
translation: 嘿嘿……不过我猜这艘船以前是你弟弟的吧，嗯？

raw_source: Pirates already looted most of it, but I found a working equipment repair bay!
translation: 海盗已经把大部分东西都抢走了，但我找到了一台还能用的装备修理舱！

raw_source: Heya Yiffany! How can I help you?
translation: 嘿，伊法妮！有什么我能帮你的吗？

raw_source: Bye bye, agent!
translation: 拜拜，特工！

raw_source: Hello there Mr. Puppy! Do you want to be my rubber ducky?
translation: 你好呀，小狗先生！你想当我的橡皮鸭吗？

raw_source: All you have do is stay here and listen to me talk about computers all day!
translation: 你只要待在这里，听我一整天聊电脑就行！

raw_source: Hey! Where are you going ducky?! We've got refactoring to do!
translation: 嘿！你要去哪儿啊，小鸭鸭？！咱们还有重构要做呢！

raw_source: Are you delivering my weekly supplies? I still have some leftover.
translation: 你是来送每周补给的？我还剩着一些呢。

raw_source: Since last cycle, I've been increasing my efficiency coefficient while usin-
translation: 从上个周期起，我一直在提高自己的效率系数，同时用——

raw_source: -wait a sec, you're not the delivery guy! G-get out of here right now!
translation: -等等，你不是送货的！快、快给我出去！

raw_source: Huh... nothing happened? I'm sure I debugged everything.
translation: 咦……什么都没发生？我确定我把所有东西都调试过了。

raw_source: Maybe reality isn't actually a simulation after all...?
translation: 也许现实其实并不是模拟出来的……？

raw_source: According to my calculations, your tazer should be fully repaired!
translation: 根据我的计算，你的电击枪应该已经完全修好了！

raw_source: With a few modifications by yours truly, probably better than it ever was, in fact!
translation: 加上我亲自做的改动，说不定比原来更好用！

raw_source: Are you worried about voiding the warranty? Pft.
translation: 你是担心会让保修失效吗？噗。

raw_source: Oh well. Have you got something else for me to work on?
translation: 算了。你还有别的活儿要我干吗？

raw_source: That should have worked! I'm sure of it!!
translation: 那本该起作用的！我很确定！！

raw_source: I'll need to run more simulations before we try again!
translation: 在我们再试一次之前，我得先跑更多模拟！

raw_source: Hang tight, this should only take two more weeks...
translation: 再撑一下，这应该只需要再多两个星期……

raw_source: Hey wait! I already fixed that for you!
translation: 嘿，等等！我已经帮你修好了！

raw_source: If I overclock it any more it'll probably catch fire...
translation: 如果我再继续超频，它大概会着火……

raw_source: How about we do something else?
translation: 我们做点别的怎么样？

raw_source: I see you've been having some real trouble finding those chips.
translation: 我看你找那些芯片可真是费了不少劲。

raw_source: Fortunately, I've got a solution... well, I think!
translation: 幸好我有个办法……嗯，我觉得有！

raw_source: With my novel algorithms - and the energy afforded by this site - I believe
translation: 凭我新颖的算法 - 以及此地供给的能量 - 我相信

raw_source: I can hack into the simulation that drives our very reality...
translation: 我能侵入驱动我们这个现实的模拟程序……

raw_source: Then we could have all the chips we'd ever need, with no downsides probably!
translation: 那样我们就有永远用不完的芯片了，而且大概没有任何坏处！

raw_source: How about it? Wanna try?! Let's hack the world!
translation: 怎么样？想试试？！我们来黑掉这个世界吧！

raw_source: Hey, wait a minute! You don't have enough components for this!
translation: 嘿，等一下！你的零件不够做这个！

raw_source: I need isolinear modules pushing at least 400 terahertz.
translation: 我需要至少能跑到 400 太赫兹的等线性模块。

raw_source: Anything else is basically too slow to even bother with!
translation: 别的基本上太慢了，根本不值得一试！

raw_source: Did you know this whole asteroid is actually wired with an advanced power grid?
translation: 你知道吗，这整颗小行星其实都铺设了先进的电网？

raw_source: It's pretty awesome... and guess what? Something buried in this rock seems to be
translation: 相当厉害吧……你猜怎么着？这块岩石里埋着的什么东西似乎

raw_source: drawing a load of power too... I haven't been able to localize it yet, though.
translation: 也在猛耗电力……不过，我还未能确定它的位置。

raw_source: If you collect enough chips, I could hack into the power grid and get this
translation: 只要你收集到足够的芯片，我就能侵入电网，把这个

raw_source: repair bay back online.
translation: 维修区重新上线。

raw_source: Have you found all the Chips laying around yet?
translation: 你已经把散落在各处的芯片都找到了吗？

raw_source: We'll need all of them in order to get this repair bay working again!
translation: 要让这台修理舱重新运转，我们需要全部芯片！

raw_source: If you need help finding more Chips, there's a weird old dog in the area
translation: 如果你需要帮忙找更多芯片，这一带有一只奇怪的老狗

raw_source: that sells a neat piece of gear that will help you find them!
translation: 它卖着一件挺不错的装备，能帮你找到它们！

raw_source: Wow, this thing is really *trashed*, but I can tell it used to be top of the line.
translation: 哇，这东西真是*烂透了*，不过我看得出它从前是顶级货。

raw_source: Throw me those chips and let's see what this repair bay can do!
translation: 把那些芯片丢给我，看看这个维修区能有什么本事！

raw_source: [...COME IN AGENT YIFFANY! PLEASE RESPOND!]
translation: [……呼叫伊法妮特工！请回答！]

raw_source: [HEYA! AGENT YIFFANY HEARING YOU LOUD AND CLEAR!]
translation: [嗨！伊法妮特工收到，声音很清楚！]

raw_source: [THANK GOODNESS! WE THOUGHT WE LOST YOU TOO!]
translation: [谢天谢地！我们还以为连你也失联了！]

raw_source: [NAH, I GOT RUFFED UP A LITTLE BIT ON ENTRY ]
translation: [没事，刚进来时挨了几下而已。]

raw_source: Thanks lad. I'll head back to the hangar in a little while.
translation: 谢谢，小伙子。我过一会儿就回机库。

raw_source: I was investigating this room for clues, when someone turned the barrier on...
translation: 我正在这个房间里找线索，不知谁就把屏障打开了……

raw_source: Trapped like a kit, how amateurish...
translation: 像只小猫一样被困住，真不专业……

raw_source: I'll be sure not to go poking my nose where it doesn't belong, next time!
translation: 下次我一定不会再把鼻子伸进不该伸的地方了！

raw_source: O-oh hey there. I'm glad to see another agent!
translation: 哦、哦，你好。能见到别的特工真高兴！

raw_source: Thank you Yiffai!
translation: 谢谢你，伊法伊！

raw_source: I guess I'm not getting rescued today? O-okay, well... I'll be waiting.
translation: 看来今天是没人来救我了？好、好吧，那……我会等着。

raw_source: Oh, it's a dog!
translation: 哦，是只狗！

raw_source: Can you get your master to come back with a key? I'm locked up in here!
translation: 你能让你的主人带着钥匙回来吗？我被锁在这里面了！

raw_source: Please come back soon with your master, and a key!
translation: 请早点带着你的主人和一把钥匙回来！

raw_source: B-b-but you already have a key! Was it something I said? Sorry!
translation: 可、可、可是你已经有钥匙了！是我说错什么了吗？对不起！

raw_source: I've... already tried picking the lock. I'm afraid you'll have to find a key...
translation: 我……已经试过撬锁了。恐怕你得去找把钥匙……

raw_source: Oh? Are you gonna let me out?!
translation: 哦？你是要放我出去吗？！

raw_source: W-wow! Thanks!
translation: 哇、哇哦！谢谢！

raw_source: I've... already tried picking the lock. I'm afraid you'll have to find a key...
translation: 我……已经试过撬锁了。恐怕你得去找把钥匙……

raw_source: I... I think I can take it from here.
translation: 我……我想接下来我自己能行了。

raw_source: I thought you were a dwarf at first. They aren't very nice!
translation: 我一开始还以为你是矮人。他们可不怎么友善！

raw_source: You know, I think I've had enough of the mines!
translation: 说真的，我已经受够矿井了！

raw_source: Hello! Can I get you something?
translation: 你好！想买点什么？

raw_source: Bye bye! Come back with lots of Lect!
translation: 再见啦！下次记得多带点Lect来！

raw_source: Gee, this would go real well with a gi, wouldn't it?
translation: 哎呀，这玩意儿配道服正合适，不是吗？

raw_source: Why, who even needs a tazer when you'd be kitted out like that!
translation: 哎呀，你这身装备还用得着电击枪吗！

raw_source: Nothing like a nice bone to satisfy your craving!
translation: 没有比一根好骨头更能解馋的了！

raw_source: Gives you a bit of vigor, too!
translation: 还能让你添点儿活力！

raw_source: A real live psy crystal, just like those espers use!
translation: 货真价实的精神力水晶，跟那些超能力者用的一样！

raw_source: You look like a smart and eager dog!
translation: 你看起来真是只聪明又有干劲的狗！

raw_source: Did you know that ferals are able to dig up dirt by pressing DOWN+ATTACK?
translation: 你知道野兽形态可以按DOWN+ATTACK挖开泥土吗？

raw_source: It's just good info to know, ya know!
translation: 这可是实用的小知识，记着没坏处！

raw_source: I've heard rumors of Espers running around nowadays! Ridiculous!
translation: 听说最近有超能力者四处活动！真是荒唐！

raw_source: They say some can even shoot energy to hit switches from far away, bah!
translation: 还说有些能发射能量，隔着老远打中开关，呸！

raw_source: It's just one crazy rumor after another out here, I tell ya.
translation: 跟你说，这儿的离谱传闻真是一个接一个。

raw_source: Somebody was telling me that they saw a Werehund in the lower levels, even.
translation: 甚至有人跟我说，在下层看见了一只狼犬。

raw_source: Oh hi, it's pretty rare to get visitors here!
translation: 哦，你好，这儿可难得有客人来！

raw_source: Remember, this is our little secret!
translation: 记住了，这是咱们俩的小秘密！

raw_source: Take some lect, but don't tell anyone, alright?
translation: 拿点 lect 吧，可别跟人说，行吗？

raw_source: Running all these shops all over Tutone, all at once... it's hard work!
translation: 图托恩各处这么多店同时开着……真辛苦！

raw_source: Not nearly as hard as developing Cosmobreeder Yiffai, but hard work still!
translation: 没开发《宇宙育种者伊法伊》苦，可挺累人！

raw_source: What, is taking all my money not good enough?
translation: 怎么，把我钱全拿走还不够？

raw_source: Why don't you take off next, huh punk?
translation: 接下来你怎么不走人呢，啊，小混混？

raw_source: Didn't you hear me? There's nothing left!
translation: 你没听见我说话吗？什么都没剩下了！

raw_source: Go be greedy somewhere else!
translation: 想贪，就去别处贪！

raw_source: Grrrr.... some folks are just absolutely SHAMELESS!
translation: 呜……有些家伙简直太不要脸了！

raw_source: Why don't you just take EVERYTHING you can get your hands on? Huh?
translation: 你怎么不干脆把能拿到的东西全拿走啊？嗯？

raw_source: Go on, do it! GEKKYZAA!!!!
translation: 来啊，拿啊！GEKKYZAA!!!!

raw_source: Hey there! Don't be a stranger, come on in!
translation: 嘿，你好！别见外，快进来吧！

raw_source: Bye for now! You take care, you hear!
translation: 先这样啦！你多保重，听见没！

raw_source: You're kinda early! Come back later and we can chat and drink, alright?
translation: 你来得有点早！晚点再来，咱们喝点东西聊聊天，好吗？

raw_source: Well! That last quake just wrecked my whole supply!
translation: 唉！上次地震把我的存货全毁了！

raw_source: I'll tell you what though, you seem like you're a good strong pupper.
translation: 不过说真的，你看着是只挺棒又壮实的狗狗。

raw_source: Another one of you cosmofellas came by muttering that they left
translation: 之前还来过一个跟你一样的太空伙计，嘴里嘀咕着说把

raw_source: their weapon just north of here!
translation: 武器落在这儿正北边了！

raw_source: "Bottom, middle, middle, top..." is what they kept saying, whatever that means!
translation: 那家伙一直念叨着"下、中、中、上……"，谁知道是什么意思！

raw_source: If nobody's claimed that ol' weapon yet, it's as good as yours, I say! Take it!
translation: 要是那把旧武器还没人认领，我说就归你了！拿去吧！

raw_source: Oh, hey! I was just about to break out of here!
translation: 哦，嗨！我正要从这里逃出去呢！

raw_source: I'll be right behind you!
translation: 我马上跟在你后面！

raw_source: W-wait! Come back!
translation: 等、等一下！回来呀！

raw_source: Oh, it's a little dog?
translation: 哦，是只小狗？

raw_source: Huh? Are you a good dog? Can you go get someone to help?
translation: 嗯？你是条好狗狗吗？能去找人来帮忙吗？

raw_source: Good boy! Come back with your master!
translation: 乖孩子！带你的主人回来！

raw_source: It's not like I *need* your help... well, probably not.
translation: 我又不是*需要*你帮忙……好吧，大概不需要。

raw_source: I've just about got this door open.
translation: 我就快把这扇门弄开了。

raw_source: But if you wanna try to break it down, I guess I can't complain...
translation: 不过你要想试着把门砸开，我也没什么好抱怨的……

raw_source: Wow! Thanks a lot!
translation: 哇！太感谢了！

raw_source: I think I can handle this from here.
translation: 接下来我想自己能搞定了。

raw_source: I'm - hmf - trying to access the electronics for this door.
translation: 我在——哼——想办法接上这扇门的电子线路。

raw_source: But it's a little tougher than I expected.
translation: 不过比我想的难了一点。

raw_source: Hmm... if I could have just gotten into that panel...
translation: 嗯……要是能打开那个面板就好了……

raw_source: Well, thanks anyway.
translation: 总之，还是谢谢你。

raw_source: Listen up, rookie! Your immediate assistance is required.
translation: 听好了，新兵！现在需要你立刻来支援。

raw_source: Hmph! They'll just graduate anyone these days...
translation: 哼！如今这年头，什么人都能毕业了……

raw_source: Recovering that key is your highest priority. Get to it!
translation: 找回那把钥匙是你最优先的任务。快去办！

raw_source: A dog, really?
translation: 真的是条狗？

raw_source: Go on, get out of here mutt!
translation: 去去，从这儿滚出去，杂种狗！

raw_source: How useless...
translation: 真没用……

raw_source: It's pretty basic, rook. Put the key in the lock and *turn*.
translation: 挺简单的，菜鸟。把钥匙插进锁里，*转*。

raw_source: Do I have to explain it to you again?
translation: 还得我再给你解释一遍吗？

raw_source: Stop standing around like you're fresh out of the academy and free me!
translation: 别像个刚出学院的新手似的傻站着，快放开我！

raw_source: Wow, *good job*. Want me to ask command to give you a gold star?
translation: 哇，*真能干*。要不要我请指挥部给你颁颗小金星？

raw_source: What?! You don't have a key?!
translation: 什么？！你连钥匙都没有？！

raw_source: Why, of all the incompetent-! Well, go and fetch one immediately!
translation: 怎么会这么没用——！好吧，马上去弄一把来！

raw_source: Your assistance is no longer needed, rookie.
translation: 不需要你的协助了，菜鸟。

raw_source: A few of the locals caught me in a dastardly sneak attack.
translation: 几个当地人卑鄙地偷袭，把我逮住了。

raw_source: By the time I came to, they'd locked me up in here. The cowards!
translation: 等我醒过来，他们就已经把我关在这里了。一群胆小鬼！

raw_source: Tch, should have just done this myself! Now don't you have errands to run, rookie?
translation: 啧，早该自己动手的！你手上不是还有跑腿的活儿吗，菜鸟？

raw_source: Well hey there, boy. I gots some real pree-mo dining here.
translation: 哟，小子。我这儿有真正的顶——级美食。

raw_source: Well look what we have here! Come in, come in! Welcome to my junk shop!
translation: 哟，瞧瞧谁来了！快进来！欢迎光临我的废品铺！

raw_source: Be seeing you. Heh-heh...
translation: 回头见。嘿嘿……

raw_source: Take care out there. Ole Tutone's a rough place these days.
translation: 出去小心点。如今的图托恩可不太平。

raw_source: Remember, no refunds! What else you need? He! He! He!
translation: 记住，概不退款！还要点啥？嘿！嘿！嘿！

raw_source: Thanks for taking that off my hands.
translation: 多谢你帮我把这东西脱手。

raw_source: They get a bit uppity at 3P stations when you gots stolen equipment...
translation: 带着偷来的装备去3P空间站，他们可会摆臭脸……

raw_source: Well are you buying or not? Don't waste my time...
translation: 到底买不买？别浪费我时间……

raw_source: You stupid or something?! That was my last one!
translation: 你是不是傻？！那是最后一个了！

raw_source: This ain't a peepshow, punk! Show me the lect or get out!
translation: 这儿可不是给你白看的，混蛋！拿出LECT来，不然滚蛋！

raw_source: Hey, you don't even have room for that!
translation: 喂，你都没地方装这个了！

raw_source: The slaves always gimme lip about the flies. Extra protein, I say!
translation: 奴隶老跟我抱怨苍蝇。我说这叫加餐补蛋白！

raw_source: I gotta be honest with you, I don't know what animal this is from.
translation: 说实话，我也不知道这是从哪种动物身上弄来的。

raw_source: Makes for good drinkin' if you're *real* thirsty though.
translation: 不过你要是*真的*渴坏了，喝着还挺不错。

raw_source: Business been pretty good lately, what with all you spacebrats wandering around.
translation: 最近生意不错，多亏你们这些太空小鬼到处晃悠。

raw_source: This here? One of them tazers those cute lil spacebrats carry around.
translation: 这个？就是那些可爱的太空小混蛋随身带的电击枪。

raw_source: A real primo, high end model too... except it's broken.
translation: 还是顶级的高端型号呢……只可惜坏了。

raw_source: But the scrap alone will go for a thousand lect, off world. How about it?
translation: 可光卖废料，拿到外星都能卖一千LECT。怎么样？

raw_source: All the cosmo-junk I sell has a story behind it.
translation: 我卖的每件宇宙破烂，背后都有段故事。

raw_source: Reeeall good stories, heh-heh...
translation: 那可都是绝——妙的故事，嘿嘿……

raw_source: You smell pretty cute for a kobold, heh-heh. What crew you fly in with?
translation: 你身上这味道对科博德来说真够可爱的，嘿嘿。你跟哪一伙船员一起飞？

raw_source: What the-? A dog?!
translation: 什么鬼——？一条狗？！

raw_source: Scram, mutt! Get back in the cage!
translation: 滚开，杂种狗！滚回笼子里去！

raw_source: Rawr! Come right on in, but only if you have plenty of Lect on you! Rawr!
translation: 嗷！尽管进来，不过身上得带够Lect才行！嗷！

raw_source: Grrr, bring more Lect with you next time, ya scoundrel!
translation: 咕呜，下次多带点 Lect 来，你这混蛋！

raw_source: Look I know it's hard to believe, but I'm not actually a Kobold pirate!
translation: 听着，我知道这很难相信，但我其实不是科博德海盗！

raw_source: It's true! But if you want a disguise as good as mine, you can buy this.
translation: 真的！不过你要是想弄一身跟我一样好的伪装，可以买这个。

raw_source: You'll need the full set in order to fool folks, but trust me...
translation: 想骗过别人，你得凑齐一整套，不过相信我……

raw_source: ...it's the only way to get the GOOD goods from the slavers, hehe!
translation: ……这是从奴隶贩子那儿弄到「好货」的唯一办法，嘿嘿！

raw_source: Plus, I'll throw in a map to the other disguise parts too!
translation: 另外，我还会顺带送你一张标注其他伪装部件的地图！

raw_source: A real live psy crystal, just like those espers use!
translation: 货真价实的精神力水晶，跟那些超能力者用的一样！

raw_source: Just look at this thick and meaty shank! Juicy and VIT-filling!
translation: 瞧瞧这粗壮又多肉的腿肉！鲜嫩多汁，还能补充活力！

raw_source: I know I look like a Space Pirate, but I'm really just a dog like you!
translation: 我知道自己像太空海盗，但我跟你一样只是条狗！

raw_source: If you get a full set of Kobo gear, you could fool people too.
translation: 要是弄到一整套科博装备，你也能骗过别人。

raw_source: The scariest part about this outfit...
translation: 这身行头最吓人的地方……

raw_source: ...is that sometimes the zipper gets stuck!
translation: ……就是拉链有时候会卡住！

raw_source: Don't forget to take some food for your pets!
translation: 别忘了给你的宠物带点吃的！

raw_source: Oh hey! Sorry, I didn't see you come in there.
translation: 哦嘿！抱歉，我没看见你走进来。

raw_source: ...in fact, I can't see anything! It's too dark!
translation: ……其实我什么都看不见！这里太黑了！

raw_source: And here you are, to brighten up my day!
translation: 你一来，我这一天都亮堂了！

raw_source: You and that torch are lifesavers.
translation: 你和那支手电筒真是救星。

raw_source: If you come across a lantern or something, come share some light with me, eh?
translation: 要是找到灯笼什么的，就来给我也照个亮，好吗？

raw_source: Look buddy, if I could see where anything is I'd gladly sell that to you
translation: 听着，老兄，要是我能看清东西在哪儿，我很乐意卖给你

raw_source: But every time I move I seem to step on somethi-YEOWCH!
translation: 但我每次一动，好像都会踩到什——嗷呜！

raw_source: Nope, no sales until the lights are back on. Sorry!
translation: 不行，灯亮之前不卖东西。抱歉！

raw_source: This is a pretty little elven letter opener, if I do say so myself!
translation: 要我自己说，这可是一把精巧的精灵拆信刀！

raw_source: Feather light, just like how those dresses the elves craft will make you feel.
translation: 轻得像羽毛，就像精灵们缝的那些裙子会让你感觉的那样。

raw_source: ...not that I would know anything about those!
translation: ……当然，那些裙子我一点都不了解！

raw_source: This here little pill will perk you up, thicken your hair, straighten yer back...
translation: 这颗小药丸能让你精神抖擞、毛发浓密、腰板挺直……

raw_source: ...and even increase your vitality!
translation: ……甚至还能提升你的活力！

raw_source: Now how about that?
translation: 怎么样，厉害吧？

raw_source: This is just my luck, isn't it?
translation: 我的运气还真是好啊，是吧？

raw_source: First somewan stole my hookshot so I have to walk around on these tiny legs...
translation: 先是有人偷了我的钩索，害我只能靠这两条小短腿走路……

raw_source: ...and now the power is out and my flashlight is missing! Bah!
translation: ……而现在又停电了，手电筒也不见了！哼！

raw_source: It's been getting ruffer and ruffer to do business around these parts, let me tell ya.
translation: 跟你说吧，在这一带做生意是越来越难了。

raw_source: Earthquakes happen every other hour and the monsters are rowdier than ever...
translation: 隔一个小时就地震一次，魔物也比以前更闹腾了……

raw_source: ...it almost feels like things are building up to something!
translation: ……总觉得好像有什么大事要发生了！

raw_source: So anyways, you ever wear an Elven dress before? You look like the sort!
translation: 话说回来，你以前穿过精灵连衣裙吗？你看着就像会穿的！

raw_source: Rumors say they prevent blocks from crumbling beneath your feet
translation: 听说它们能防止脚下的方块崩塌，

raw_source: thanks to some sort of nano machines...
translation: 靠的是什么纳米机器……

raw_source: ...but I think it's actually just magic!
translation: ……不过我觉得其实就是魔法！

raw_source: H-howdy friend! I'd give ya a warm welcome, but I'm awful cooped up!
translation: 你、你好啊，朋友！我倒想热情欢迎你，可这里实在太挤了！

raw_source: Be seein' ya!
translation: 回头见啦！

raw_source: Now this ain't funny, pup! You get back here!
translation: 这可不好笑，小狗！给我回来！

raw_source: Well hii there, little doggy!
translation: 哎呀，你好呀，小狗狗！

raw_source: Guess'n you can't help me yerself, doggy... so are you gonna get somebody who can?
translation: 看来你自己帮不了我，小狗狗……那你能去找个帮得上忙的人来吗？

raw_source: Good doggy! Bring back help!
translation: 好狗狗！快去找帮手回来！

raw_source: P-please! I'm askin' ya real nice-like!
translation: 拜、拜托！我都这么客客气气地求你了！

raw_source: I've been cooped up here for stars knows how long. Can ya gimme me a hand?
translation: 只有星星才知道我被关在这儿多久了。能帮我一把吗？

raw_source: Thankyah kindly!
translation: 真是太感谢你啦！

raw_source: Awful kind of ya, helpin' me, but I'm doin' alright now.
translation: 你可真够意思，还来帮我；不过我现在已经好多了。

raw_source: Now why would someone go lockin' up an innocent tod like me?
translation: 到底谁会把我这么无辜的公狐狸关起来啊？

raw_source: A fine sortie, all told, but I'm hankerin' for a bit of R and R after this!
translation: 这一趟出击总体打得不错，不过之后我可真盼着能歇上一歇！

raw_source: Oh hi there! I'm not really in trouble, it just looks like it!
translation: 哦，你好！我其实没遇上麻烦，只是看起来像而已！

raw_source: Just wait 'til I find my tazer again, those elves won't know what hit 'em!
translation: 等我找回电击器，那些精灵连自己怎么挨打的都不会知道！

raw_source: I'll break out of here myself!
translation: 我自己会逃出去的！

raw_source: Oh, it's a dog!
translation: 哦，是只狗！

raw_source: Do you wanna keep me company while I think of how to break outta here, boy?
translation: 小伙子，要不要陪陪我，等我想出逃出去的办法？

raw_source: Nooo? That's a shame...
translation: 不——想？真可惜……

raw_source: Right. You might as well save your strength for someone who needs it!
translation: 对嘛。还是把力气留给真正需要帮助的人吧！

raw_source: I guess if you *really* want to help...
translation: 我想，要是你*真的*那么想帮忙……

raw_source: Well, thanks. This'll make my conquest of the elves even easier!
translation: 好吧，谢谢。这样征服精灵就更容易了！

raw_source: No more need for your tazer! I'll take it from here!
translation: 用不着你的电击枪了！接下来交给我！

raw_source: I was single-pawwedly conquering the elven empire here.
translation: 我本来正在单爪征服这里的精灵帝国。

raw_source: But I hit a little setback. Nothing for a trainee like you to worry over!
translation: 不过遇到了一点挫折。用不着你这样的见习生操心！

raw_source: Getting the best of these Sceafyan elves is a real workout!
translation: 要压过这些斯凯菲亚精灵，还真挺费劲！

raw_source: But don't worry about me, trainee. I'll be fine.
translation: 不过别担心我，见习生。我会没事的。

raw_source: Oh h-hey, I've been waiting for another agent to stop by.
translation: 哦，嗨、嗨，我一直在等别的特工过来。

raw_source: Got into a spot of trouble. You know how it is... right?
translation: 遇上了点麻烦。你懂的……对吧？

raw_source: Thank you Yiffai!
translation: 谢谢你，伊法伊！

raw_source: Take your time... us senior agents know how to keep our cool.
translation: 慢慢来……我们这些资深特工，最懂得保持冷静。

raw_source: A dog, eh?
translation: 是条狗啊？

raw_source: Why don't you run along and fetch someone who can let me out of here?
translation: 不如你去找个能放我出去的人回来？

raw_source: Run along, pup! I'll be waiting!
translation: 去吧，小狗！我等着你！

raw_source: Are you playing around or something? Cut it out!
translation: 你是在玩我吗？别闹了！

raw_source: Cute. But unless you're a master locksmith I think you'll need a key.
translation: 可爱。但除非你是开锁大师，否则我看你得要钥匙。

raw_source: Oh! You're gonna rescue me?
translation: 哦！你要救我？

raw_source: There! We make a great team, with you doing all the work, haha!
translation: 瞧！我们真是绝佳搭档，活儿全让你干了，哈哈！

raw_source: There's no way to get this lock open without a key. Believe me, I've tried.
translation: 没有钥匙就打不开这把锁。相信我，我试过了。

raw_source: The lock's open. Maybe go find someone else to rescue...?
translation: 锁已经开了。不如去找其他人救……？

raw_source: Really... I'm a pretty cool cat. No rush on the rescue.
translation: 真的……我可是只淡定的猫。救援不着急。

raw_source: I was the senior top agent deployed to this planet.
translation: 我可是派驻这颗星球的资深上位特工。

raw_source: If you bust me out of here, I'll show you a few tricks, haha!
translation: 你要是把我弄出去，我就教你几招，哈哈！

raw_source: Thanks for rescuing me!
translation: 谢谢你救了我！

raw_source: Nice night in the forest huh?
translation: 森林里今晚夜色不错，是吧？

raw_source: A fine night to enjoy some fine dining, wouldn't you say?
translation: 这样的夜晚正适合享用一顿美餐，你说是不是？

raw_source: Well lookee here, a friendly face. Welcome to the black market!
translation: 哟，瞧瞧这儿，一张友善的面孔。欢迎来到黑市！

raw_source: Be seeing you. Heh-heh...
translation: 回头见。嘿嘿……

raw_source: Take care out there. Ole Tutone's a rough place these days.
translation: 出去小心点。如今的图托恩可不太平。

raw_source: Remember, no refunds! What else you need? He! He! He!
translation: 记住，概不退款！还要点啥？嘿！嘿！嘿！

raw_source: Wow, thanks! I didn't think I'd ever find a kobold to buy these!
translation: 哇，多谢！我还以为找不到肯买这些的科博德呢！

raw_source: Well are you buying or not? Don't waste my time...
translation: 到底买不买？别浪费我时间……

raw_source: Just have fun with your trash and leave me be, okay?!
translation: 你就拿着你的破烂玩去吧，别来烦我，行吗？！

raw_source: Nope, no take-backs! I don't care how much those cards tingle in your pocket.
translation: 不行，没有反悔这回事！我才不管那些卡在你兜里有多让人发麻。

raw_source: This ain't a peepshow, punk! Show me the lect or get out!
translation: 这儿可不是给你白看的，混蛋！拿出LECT来，不然滚蛋！

raw_source: Hey, you don't even have room for that!
translation: 喂，你都没地方装这个了！

raw_source: What? You're interested in THAT?
translation: 什么？你对那玩意儿感兴趣？

raw_source: I have the finest food this side of the seven swamps, and you want THAT garbage?
translation: 我这儿的吃食是七片沼泽这一带最好的，你却想要那种垃圾？

raw_source: Fine, but it'll cost ya...
translation: 行吧，不过这可要花你钱的……

raw_source: Oh? You want to try my special meat?
translation: 哦？你想试试我的特别的肉？

raw_source: Can't say you don't have guts, heh-heh...
translation: 不能说你没胆子，嘿嘿……

raw_source: We boiled it for so long we forgot what it was.
translation: 我们煮了太久，都忘了它是什么。

raw_source: But a little sip never hurt anyone, right?
translation: 不过喝一小口从来不会伤到谁，对吧？

raw_source: You ever think about becoming a space pirate?
translation: 你有没有想过成为太空海盗？

raw_source: Lot more loot in it than being a cosmo agent, hen-heh...
translation: 比当宇宙特工能捞到的好处多多了，嘿嘿……

raw_source: Just looks like a deck of weird little cards... right? Think again!
translation: 看起来不过是一叠古怪的小卡片……对吧？那你可想错了！

raw_source: One touch, and you can feel the PSY power leaching off of them.
translation: 只要碰一下，你就能感觉到精神力正从上面渗出来。

raw_source: It's said that a skilled ESPer could *use* this power.
translation: 据说熟练的超能力者能够*使用*这种力量。

raw_source: I'll be honest: all this PSY stuff gives me the creeps.
translation: 老实说：这些精神力的东西让我发毛。

raw_source: Jus' don't blow me up and we'll be golden, okay?
translation: 就别把我炸了，咱们就妥了，好吗？

raw_source: Most kobolds don't really do all these mind games. I get it if y'ain't interested.
translation: 大多数科博德并不真搞这些心理把戏。你要是没兴趣，我理解。

raw_source: Any ole club and a length of rope'll do me just fine... All direct-like, ya-know?
translation: 随便一根旧棍子加一段绳子就够我用了……全都直接来的，懂吧？

raw_source: What the-? A dog?!
translation: 什么鬼——？一条狗？！

raw_source: Scram, mutt! You're not getting any food from me!
translation: 滚开，杂种狗！我这儿一点吃的都不会给你！

raw_source: Whew! What a climb up here huh? Really takes the wind out of ya!
translation: 呼！爬上来这一趟够呛吧？真是累得人喘不上气！

raw_source: You're real daring, going out without a spacesuit on!
translation: 不穿宇航服就往外跑，你胆子可真大！

raw_source: You get 'em, tiger!
translation: 加油，猛将，去收拾他们吧！

raw_source: Bye! I'd toast to your health, but I know you can't drink with that helm on!
translation: 再见！本想举杯祝你健康，可我知道你戴着那头盔没法喝！

raw_source: Fancy yourself an explorer?
translation: 觉得自己是个探险家？

raw_source: Then you probably aren't interested in this...
translation: 那你大概对这东西没兴趣……

raw_source: This little doohicky will detect anomalies
translation: 这小玩意儿能探测异常，

raw_source: and it'll even mark important things on your Navmap!
translation: 还能在你的导航地图上标出重要的东西！

raw_source: Great for cleaning up all the areas you've been to.
translation: 用来查漏补缺、扫遍去过的区域再合适不过了。

raw_source: Isn't technology great? This new G+RADIO is a radio and anomaly detector...
translation: 科技真棒，不是吗？这款新G+RADIO既是收音机，也是异常探测器……

raw_source: ...and it even has a calculator built in!
translation: ……甚至还内置了计算器！

raw_source: The worst part about all this space walking is having to wear a space suit.
translation: 太空行走最糟的，就是得穿宇航服。

raw_source: It gets my fur all mussed up!
translation: 弄得我的毛全乱了！

raw_source: Oh hi! Haven't seen one of you cosmo fellas in a while!
translation: 哦，你好！好久没见到你们这种宇宙来的家伙了！

raw_source: Welcome welcome! Bring your appetite! And your Lect!
translation: 欢迎欢迎！带上你的胃口！还有你的 Lect！

raw_source: Buh bye! I know we'll meat again!
translation: 拜拜啦！我知道我们还会再见的！

raw_source: Fried to perfection, this little snack will fill you with vigor!
translation: 这份小吃炸得恰到好处，吃了让你活力满满！

raw_source: Ahh, in need of something a bit more substantial, are ya? Good choice!
translation: 啊，想来点更顶饱的，是吧？好眼光！

raw_source: This premium slab of meat will get you back on your feet in no time!
translation: 这块上等好肉能让你立马恢复精神！

raw_source: Just look at this thick and meaty shank! Juicy and VIT-filling!
translation: 瞧瞧这粗壮又多肉的腿肉！鲜嫩多汁，还能补充活力！

raw_source: Heyhey, if it isn't the great hero of Tutone!
translation: 嘿嘿，这不是图托恩的大英雄嘛！

raw_source: With all these folks recovering here, business has been booming!
translation: 有这么多人在这儿养伤，生意红火得很！

raw_source: Feel free to buy as much meat as you need, stocks won't run out.
translation: 想买多少肉尽管买，存货管够。

raw_source: Starting to get lively in here, isn't it?
translation: 这儿总算开始热闹起来了，对吧？

raw_source: I keep bringing in food, and you fellas keep on eating it up!
translation: 我一批批把吃的运进来，你们这帮家伙就一个劲地吃光！

raw_source: Almost makes me think that I should bring in some of the GOOD stuff...
translation: 都快让我觉得该进点“好东西”了……

raw_source: There's not much reason to stock a lot of food right now
translation: 眼下没什么理由囤太多吃的

raw_source: But you know, if there were more folks resting up in this hangar
translation: 可你知道，要是这机库里多些人休整

raw_source: I could probably stand to bring in more provisions...
translation: 我倒也许该多运些补给进来……

raw_source: It's been so long since I saw another one of you agent sorts here
translation: 我好久没在这儿见到你们这种探员了

raw_source: that I haven't even kept the stocks up!
translation: 连存货都没顾上补！

raw_source: Maybe if there were folks to eat the food, I could bring some in...
translation: 要是有谁来吃这些东西，也许我就能进些货……

raw_source: Not hungry after all, huh?
translation: 到头来还是不饿，是吧？

raw_source: There you go! Eat up!
translation: 给你！尽情吃吧！

raw_source: Doesn't your boss pay ya? Come back with some more Lect!
translation: 你老板不给你发钱吗？多带点Lect再来！

raw_source: Hey there! Don't be a stranger, come on in!
translation: 嘿，你好！别见外，快进来吧！

raw_source: Bye for now! You take care, you hear!
translation: 先这样啦！你多保重，听见没！

raw_source: You come across any of these crazy crystals out there in the world?
translation: 你在外头见过这种神奇的水晶吗？

raw_source: They say that if an Esper gets one of these, it'd boost their psychic capacity
translation: 听说超能力者得到一颗，就能提升灵能容量，

raw_source: but I'm just a simple dog, so it does nothing for me. You can have it!
translation: 可我只是条普通的狗，这东西对我没用。送你吧！

raw_source: You been working real hard to rescue everyone, haven't you?
translation: 为了救大家，你一直很拼命吧？

raw_source: I've been busy running around from shop to shop making sure the lect flows
translation: 我忙着跑遍各家店，确保 lect 流转

raw_source: but every once in a while I need one of THESE as a lil pick-me-up!
translation: 不过偶尔我也得靠这个提提神！

raw_source: I reckon you could use one yourself about now, huh?
translation: 我寻思你这会儿也该来一份，嗯？

raw_source: I'm all out of fancy stones and meds now...
translation: 我现在已经没有那些稀奇的石头和药品了……

raw_source: ...but you know, you Cosmobreeders have been good to me
translation: ……不过，你们这些宇宙育种者一直待我不错，

raw_source: so why not take a little cut of what I've earned, huh? You deserve it!
translation: 所以从我赚的钱里拿一小份吧，怎么样？这是你应得的！

raw_source: You ever hear about these ol' PSY powers that some folks be gettin' these days?
translation: 听说过最近有些人得到的那些精神力异能没？

raw_source: The say Triangle powers will boost your defense while lowering your attack a bit
translation: 听说三角能力能增强防御，不过攻击会稍微降低

raw_source: while a Cross power will do the opposite! Take AND deal more damage!
translation: 十字之力则刚好相反！挨打更疼，打人也更疼！

raw_source: Not only that, but they say... they say...
translation: 不止如此，他们还说……还说……

raw_source: ...nevermind, I forgot what they say about the other powers...
translation: ……算了，其他能力的传闻我给忘了……

raw_source: Sure are a lot of agents to rescue out there, huh?
translation: 外面要救的特工可真不少，是吧？

raw_source: Come back here after you've saved a bunch of 'em
translation: 等你救了一大批他们之后再回到这儿

raw_source: and I'll give you a little somethin somethin... He!He!He!
translation: 我就给你一点那个那个……嘿！嘿！嘿！

raw_source: ...sorry about the creepy laugh. Force of habit.
translation: ……抱歉，刚才笑得有点吓人。习惯了。

raw_source: There you go pal. You deserve it!
translation: 拿好了，伙计。这是你应得的！

raw_source: I'm out now, sorry! If I had more I'd gladly give 'em to ya!
translation: 抱歉，现在没货了！要是还有，我很乐意给你！

raw_source: COME ON IN, FELLOW BREEDER!
translation: 进来吧，同行育种者！

raw_source: BYE-OH! DON'T FORGET TO COME OFTEN!
translation: 拜拜！别忘了常来啊！

raw_source: THIS RIGHT HERE IS A TRAINER TAZER! MUCH DIFFERENT THAN THE TRAINEE TAZER!
translation: 这就是驯兽电击枪！跟学员电击枪可大不一样！

raw_source: IF YOU DEFEAT AN ENEMY WHILE WIELDING THIS, IT'LL SEND THE CREATURE HERE!
translation: 拿着它击败敌人，就会把那个生物传送到这里！

raw_source: AND WHILE THEY'RE HERE YOU CAN OBSERVE AND GROW YOUR RAPPORT WITH THEM
translation: 它们待在这里时，你可以观察它们，跟它们增进关系，

raw_source: TO UNDERSTAND MORE ABOUT THE SPECIES!
translation: 从而更深入地了解这个物种！

raw_source: NOT INTERESTED IN CAPTURING CREATURES? SURE, WE CAN TRADE BACK.
translation: 对捕捉生物没兴趣？没问题，我们可以换回来。

raw_source: YOU'RE WELCOME TO GET THE TRAINER TAZER AGAIN LATER, OF COURSE!
translation: 当然，以后想再拿驯兽电击枪，随时欢迎！

raw_source: SINCE YOU'VE GOTTEN REAL CLOSE WITH ONE OF THOSE CREATURES, TAKE THIS!
translation: 既然你已经和那些生物中的一个变得非常亲近了，把这个拿去！

raw_source: GIVE THEM SOME ATTENTION AND PETS ONE MORE TIME WHILE HOLDING THIS CRYSTAL
translation: 拿着这块水晶，再关心它们一次、摸摸它们。

raw_source: AND YOU MIGHT FEEL A CERTAIN POWER COURSE THROUGH YOU...
translation: 并且你也许会感到某种力量流经你……

raw_source: MAKE SURE TO SHOW YOUR PETS SOME AFFECTION, AND FEED THEM WELL!
translation: 一定要给宠物一点关爱，并且好好喂它们！

raw_source: AFTER YOU'VE MAXED A PET'S CONFIDENCE, RETURN HERE FOR A SPECIAL REWARD.
translation: 把宠物的自信提升到最高后，回来领取特别奖励。

raw_source: WITH THE CRYSTAL, THE CREATURES THAT LOVE YOU CAN GIVE YOU A SPECIAL BOOST!
translation: 有了这水晶，爱你的生物就能给你一份特殊加成！

raw_source: JUST PET THEM WHILE THEY'RE AT FULL CONFIDENCE TO CHARGE THE CRYSTAL.
translation: 在它们自信满满时抚摸它们，就能给水晶充能。

raw_source: EACH CREATURE GIVES A DIFFERENT POWER! TRY THEM ALL!
translation: 每种生物给的力量都不同！都试试！

raw_source: Welcome to my little shop!
translation: 欢迎光临我的小店！

raw_source: ...no, not that kind of shop! This is an auto shop!
translation: ……不，不是那种店！这是汽车修理店！

raw_source: Bye for now! You take care, you hear!
translation: 先这样啦！你多保重，听见没！

raw_source: I've asked around, and my sources say...
translation: 我打听了一圈，我的消息来源说……

raw_source: The southern part of Depot B holds a nice Ship Gun!
translation: B号仓库的南部有一门不错的飞船炮！

raw_source: It's right underneath the area where the lights go out
translation: 它就在那片灯光熄灭区域的正下方

raw_source: but you'll need a high level keycard to access it!
translation: 但你得有高级门卡才能进去！

raw_source: I've asked around, and my sources say...
translation: 我打听了一圈，我的消息来源说……

raw_source: Way down at the bottom of Ayskammr lies a nice Ship Shield!
translation: 在艾斯卡姆尔的最深处，躺着一面不错的飞船护盾！

raw_source: It's in a spooky dark cave, so try to take a light with ya!
translation: 它在一个阴森黑暗的洞穴里，所以记得带上照明！

raw_source: I've asked around, and my sources say...
translation: 我打听了一圈，我的消息来源说……

raw_source: The Elves of Sceafya have stowed away a Ship Radar!
translation: 斯凯菲亚的精灵们藏起了一台飞船雷达！

raw_source: Apparently it's in a tricky position...
translation: 据说它在一个很刁钻的位置……

raw_source: You're gonna have to be a magician or psychic to reach it!
translation: 你得是魔术师或者通灵者才够得着它！

raw_source: I've asked around, and my sources say...
translation: 我打听了一圈，我的消息来源说……

raw_source: Zeronia's really taken a beating since you got here!
translation: 自从你来了之后，泽罗尼亚可真是饱受摧残！

raw_source: Supposedly an old cache that held a Ship Turbo got revealed
translation: 据说一个装有飞船涡轮的旧藏匿点露了出来

raw_source: during the last batch of earthquakes! Go get it!
translation: 就在最近那几场地震期间！快去拿吧！

raw_source: Wow! You got a whole set of parts for this ol' ship of yours!
translation: 哇！你这艘老船的整套零件都齐了！

raw_source: I'll need time to install them, but it'll all work out now!
translation: 我需要时间把它们装上，不过现在一切都能搞定了！

raw_source: If you come across any nice upgrades for your ship out there
translation: 如果你在外面碰上什么不错的飞船升级件

raw_source: I'll install them for you, free of charge!
translation: 我就免费替你装上！

raw_source: ...well, not really free. Your boss paid me already!
translation: ……嗯，也不算真免费。你的老板已经付过我钱了！

raw_source: Don't worry about memorizing what I just told ya...
translation: 别费劲记我刚才说的那些……

raw_source: ...I marked it on your Navmap already! Go check it out!
translation: ……我已经在你的导航地图上标好了！去看看吧！

raw_source: Heyo baby bro! Welcome aboard!
translation: 嘿呀，小弟！欢迎上船！

raw_source: Bye! If you wanna help me get this ship fixed up
translation: 再见！如果你想帮我把这艘船修好

raw_source: try asking the mechanic where you can get some parts!
translation: 就去问问机修工哪儿能弄到零件！

raw_source: I can't believe that I did that evil Queen's bidding...
translation: 真不敢相信，我竟然替那个邪恶女王卖命……

raw_source: She almost has enough power to take over a new body
translation: 她几乎已经有足够的力量占据一具新的身体了

raw_source: so we gotta hurry and strike before it's too late!
translation: 所以咱们得赶快出击，趁还来得及！

raw_source: Man, this ship got beat up pretty good, didn't it?
translation: 哇，这艘船伤得可真惨，是吧？

raw_source: I'd fly you straight to where that evil Queen is hiding
translation: 我会直接把你送到那个邪恶女王藏身的地方

raw_source: but this bird can't fly that high until it's fixed up!
translation: 但这艘船没修好之前可飞不了那么高！

raw_source: You've really come a long way, haven't you?
translation: 你真的一路成长了不少，不是吗？

raw_source: Feels like you were still wetting the bed only yesterday!
translation: 感觉昨天你还在尿床呢！

raw_source: ...you've gotten over that by now, right?
translation: ……你现在应该已经改掉了吧？

raw_source: Heya Yiffai! Nice to see you up here in my brand new spacelab!
translation: 嘿，伊法伊！很高兴在这上面见到你，就在我全新的太空实验室里！

raw_source: Heheh... I guess this used to be your sister's ship though, huh?
translation: 嘿嘿……不过我想，这以前是你姐姐的飞船吧？

raw_source: Pirates already looted most of it, but I found a working equipment repair bay!
translation: 海盗已经把大部分东西都抢走了，但我找到了一台还能用的装备修理舱！

raw_source: Heya Yiffai! How can I help you?
translation: 嘿，伊法伊！有什么我能帮你的吗？

raw_source: Bye bye, agent!
